description: Create ImplementationApproval domain model with hash verification, self-approval detection, and evidence population. This is the core authorization record that binds approval to exact workflow_id, candidate_sha256, placement_manifest_sha256, target_family, and target_version. Immutable after approval granted.
steps: Create services/project-ai/app/models/implementation_approval.py with ApprovalStatus enum (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED)

Create ImplementationApproval dataclass with fields: approval_id (UUID), workflow_id (UUID), candidate_sha256, target_family, target_version, placement_manifest_id (UUID), placement_manifest_sha256, approved_by, approval_timestamp (datetime), status (ApprovalStatus), evidence (Dict), rejection_reason (Optional[str])

Add validation methods: verify_manifest_hash(manifest: PlacementManifest) -> bool, verify_candidate_hash(validation: ValidationResult) -> bool, verify_not_self_approved(requester: str) -> bool, is_valid_for_implementation() -> bool
Add evidence population method: to_evidence_dict() -> Dict[str, Any] following W3 evidence pattern (all fields populated, no empty dicts)
Use datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() for timestamp format (ISO 8601 with timezone)
Follow dataclass pattern from placement_manifest.py and candidate_validator.py

Create services/project-ai/tests/test_implementation_approval.py with tests: model creation, hash verification (manifest and candidate), self-approval detection, is_valid_for_implementation logic, evidence dict population
Use pytest fixtures for mock PlacementManifest and ValidationResult (follow pattern from test_placement_manifest.py)
All tests must use real assertions (pytest.raises for errors, assert for conditions) - no mocked passes
acceptance_criteria: ImplementationApproval dataclass exists with all 11 required fields
ApprovalStatus enum has PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED values
verify_not_self_approved() returns False if approved_by equals requester
is_valid_for_implementation() returns True only if all hashes match AND status=APPROVED AND not self-approved
to_evidence_dict() returns populated dict with approval_id, workflow_id, status, all hashes, timestamp, verification results
All test cases pass: pytest tests/test_implementation_approval.py shows 100% pass rate
verification: python -c "from app.models.implementation_approval import ImplementationApproval, ApprovalStatus; print('Model imports successfully')"
